This proposal aims to solve the following problem: The Cardano ecosystem primarily offers development tools and libraries in Haskell and JavaScript, creating a significant barrier for Python developers who wish to engage with the platform.
This limitation hinders the growth and diversification of the developer community within the Cardano ecosystem.
Furthermore, existing tools often depend on external serialization libraries, complicating the development process and potentially introducing additional points of failure.
The absence of a native Python library that seamlessly integrates with Cardano's infrastructure restricts the ability of developers to build and deploy applications efficiently.

summary: This treasury withdrawal funds PyCardano which will provide the following services: ​ PyCardano is a lightweight Python library that enables developers to interact seamlessly with the Cardano blockchain.
